text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing...
Hishi Amazon turned to me with a serious expression and stopped.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
—The time has come to settle this, Trainy.
Come with me after this!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: You'll see once we get there!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
All right, we're here!
Mmm... the air smells so fresh.
choice_data_list: A campsite along a mountain stream...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Here, we can have a serious match
with everything we've got—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Trainy!!
How 'bout you and me go one-on-one?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
What is the "most important ingredient in cooking"
that I've been searching for all this time...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I finally found it.
My own answer, that is!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna pour all of that into this dish right now
and feed it to Trainer-douche!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
If you manage to guess it right,
then that'll make it your win, Trainer!
choice_data_list: If that's the case, challenge accepted!
If that's the case, I accept the challenge!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Gotta make the best dish possible,
or all the feelings I poured in might just dull out, y'know.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I'll go procure the finest ingredients to properly meet the challenge of this big showdown!

Having gathered "bounties of the mountain stream"—river fish and wild greens—
Hishi Amazon skillfully cooks them over the campsite's outdoor stove.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Almost finished!
With Big Sis Hishi Ama's special ultra-high power burner—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I'll sear this fish in one go!!
Doryaaaaaaaah!!
(ROOOOOAAAR!!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Phew... It's done! I call it,
'The Mountain Stream BBQ That'd Make an Ogre Weep'!!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Savor it all you want, Trainer-boy! And then...
let's see if you can guess my "answer"!

Generous portions of grilled fish, along with wild vegetables bursting with rich flavor...
Every single dish was utterly delicious.

And the answer Hishi Amazon put into these dishes
regarding "what's truly important in cooking" was—
choice_data_list: With the fighting spirit to take those ingredients down!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...!
What made you think that?
I told them I could feel the "one-on-one fighting spirit" in the dish, conquering even the finest ingredients.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Not bad, Train-dude. Yeah, this very spirit
is the answer I reached for
"the most important thing in cooking."
choice_data_list: Why did you come to that answer?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: After trying all sorts of things, ya know? Knowledge, technique, soul. There were lots of important things. But...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
None of that is where my roots lie.
My roots are—the fire of Kentucky!
(ROAAAR, crackle crackle...!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yes! You overpower the finest meat with even greater fighting spirit,
and grill it to perfection!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
And just bite into it following your desire!
I want someone to know that joy. I realized
that's what my true feelings are.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: The campfire from the BBQ with my old man. To an adult, it might have been tiny, but...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
That spark has become a giant flame
blazing inside of me right now!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I kinda get it now. Why the old man told me, "You have to think for yourself."

...Hishi Amazon may have arrived at an answer
that only she could have found.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Haha, still, to have you hit the nail right on the head...
How pathetic of me.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, how does she see right through me
every single time...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Gaaaah! I give up, I give up!
I lost to you in more ways than one!
(SPLAAAASH!!)

Hishi Amazon ran up to the riverbank and—
suddenly dove straight into the mountain stream.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hahaha... I got kinda heated up, so I figured I'd cool off...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: As a penalty game, I'll just swim here for a while! Don't look this way...!

...Refusing to let anyone see her face,
Hishi Amazon dove underwater.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...Heeh.
What made you think that?

Every single dish Hishi Amazon made was seasoned
just the way I liked it...
In other words, I told her that her answer was likely to adjust to her partner.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...Too bad! That's a miss!
Guess that makes it my win, Trainy!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Well, yeah, I was pretty picky with the seasoning, but...
Let's see here, let me have a bite too...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
H-Huh...? This definitely
tastes like something Trainy would like...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Holy smokes! Could this be a winning dish?
After all, it's a dish cooked up by yours truly...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
—Ahahaha!
Alright, alright, I give up!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me to unconsciously
let myself get dragged along by good old Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Still, don't you go letting it go to your head
just because you won once!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: In our next showdown, it won't go down like this—I definitely won't lose!

In response to Hishi Amazon's words,
I told her that was just what I wanted.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ...Is that so.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Then that makes this round my win!
Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
What are you talking about, Trainy?
I never expected it to be that easy.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: "If anything, I'm way happier that you answered me honestly!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
We can go toe-to-toe—
as many times as it takes, after all!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Then let's waste no time
and get right to our next duel!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
We'll dive headfirst into that mountain streamâ
and have a contest to see who can catch river fish with their bare hands!

I spent a fun and passionate time
together with Hishi Amazon.
